spans.s: --the dissolution pertaining to प्रकृति; a state in which there is no rain for a century, famine rages and the fire of deluge consumes all spaces, accompanied by violent winds and so on. It is of four kinds; नित्य, नैमित्तिक, प्रा- कृतिक, and आत्यन्तिक; deluge, when the universe merges when the गुणस् are in a balanced state. भा.
--the seven clouds (named) which cause Pralaya. They take their origin from the steam caused by fire and cause the several oceans to become one.
